package demo;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
@NiagaraType
@NiagaraProperty(
  name = "alpha",
  type = "BRelTime",
  defaultValue = "BRelTime.make(5)",
  facets = @Facet("BFacets.make(BFacets.MIN, BRelTime.makeMinutes(3))")
)
@NiagaraProperty(name = "beta", type = "BRelTime", defaultValue = "BRelTime.make(5)")
@NiagaraProperty(name = "gamma", type = "BRelTime", defaultValue = "BRelTime.make(5)",
  facets = @Facet("BFacets.make(BFacets.MIN, someMin)"))
@NiagaraProperty(name = "delta", type = "BRelTime", defaultValue = "BRelTime.make(5)",
  facets = @Facet("BFacets.make(BFacets.MIN,BRelTime.makeHours(1))"))
public class P extends BComponent {
  public BRelTime getAlpha() { return (BRelTime) get(alpha); }
  public BRelTime getBeta() { return (BRelTime) get(beta); }
  public BRelTime getGamma() { return (BRelTime) get(gamma); }
  public BRelTime getDelta() { return (BRelTime) get(delta); }
  public BRelTime getEpsilon() {
    // nothing
    //
    //
    return (BRelTime) get("epsilon");
  }
  void a() {
    Clock.schedule(this, getAlpha(), go, null);
    Clock.schedule(this, getBeta(), go, null);
    Clock.schedule(this, getGamma(), go, null);
    Clock.schedule(this, getDelta(), go, null);
    Clock.schedule(this, getEpsilon(), go, null);
  }
}
